narr: A deep moisture surge across Southern California lead to widespread heavy thunderstorms across the mountains and deserts in the middle of August, leading to multiple days of flooding. Torrential downpours lead to severe flash flooding and debris flows near the Apple and El Dorado burn scars.
ev: Caltrans report of flash flooding with water and debris flowing over the road on Highway 78 and Borrego Springs Road.
lsr: CALTRANS REPORT OF FLASH FLOODING WITH WATER AND DEBRIS FLOWING OVER HWY 78 AND BORREGO SPRINGS ROAD.
